findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the custom software code, database schemas, and visual assets shall transfer to the Client only upon full payment of the corresponding Milestone amount.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I’ve reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a couple of adjustments before signing:

- The relevant clause currently transfers ownership of the custom software code, database schemas, and visual assets to the client as soon as each milestone is delivered, even if payment has not yet been received. I propose that ownership transfer only after full payment of the corresponding milestone amount.
- The relevant clause sets the payment deadline at ninety (90) days after the client’s final acceptance of the complete software, which can create a cash‑flow delay. I propose that payment for each milestone be due within thirty (30) days after the client’s acceptance of that milestone.

Please let me know if these changes are acceptable. Thanks for your understanding.

Best regards,
